summary: Backend testing for parametric furniture configurator. All 11 tests passed (100%): templates listing (6 types), idempotent seed-materials, gardirop full-options estimate with all 15 expected roles including LED/ayna/pantolon_askisi, per-type estimates for the other 5 templates, unknown type -> 400, PATCH /materials/{id} propagates live to /configurator/estimate BOM line_cost/material_cost, and save+GET /products recomputes cost live using current material prices after PATCH.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py GET /products default margin fallback is 30 (line 261) but Product model default is 30; configured products default via configurator.save uses margin=40. Minor inconsistency but not user-visible since margin is always saved.

seed-materials filter `{'role': {'$ne': ''}}` misses legacy materials with no 'role' field at all — those documents are excluded from `have_roles`, but that's actually the intended behavior (only roles are tracked). Fine.
configurator._gardirop: 'kenar_bant' formula uses W/kapak_sayisi inside kapak_sayisi*(H+W/kapak_sayisi) which is unusual but not incorrect.
seed_data_creation: Called /api/configurator/seed-materials (idempotent). One TEST_ConfiguredGardirop product was created and cleaned up (delete attempted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_configurator.py covers all configurator endpoints. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_configurator.py -o addopts='' (pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope which conflicts with single-file runs).
